name: OpenTutor Codespaces
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'if [ ! -f .env ]; then cp .env.example .env; fi; mkdir -p "$HOME/.opentutor"; python -m venv apps/api/.venv; apps/api/.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip; apps/api/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r apps/api/requirements-core.txt; npm ci --prefix apps/web --no-audit --no-fund'
postStartCommand: bash -lc '(cd apps/api && nohup .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 >/tmp/opentutor-api.log 2>&1 </dev/null &) && (cd apps/web && nohup npm run dev -- --hostname 0.0.0.0 >/tmp/opentutor-web.log 2>&1 </dev/null &)'
